findings.text: Device exposes statistics callbacks for names counts and values within a single string set. Name and value production share one ordering of shared totals followed by per pair groups. Count production learns geometry from an empty collection context. Value production merges device counters with driver counters and closes with locally derived totals.

Device exposes channel geometry and link setting callbacks plus an initializer for link state. Channel reporting derives combined width from current and maximum pair counts curr_queue_pairs and max_queue_pairs and reports no split receive transmit or other channels. Link retrieval returns cached speed and duplex with generic port kind while link update delegates to a virtual device helper and initialization sets both to unknown markers.

Device exposes global and per queue moderation accessors and hash size plus hash retrieval operations. Per queue operations validate an index against the maximum pair count. Hash size queries return stored key and table extents rss_key_size and rss_indir_table_size. Hash retrieval optionally copies table entries with endian conversion and key bytes and always reports a single hash function kind.

Statistics output is a flat counter array with fixed order. Receive totals precede transmit totals followed by control counters then all receive pair groups then all transmit pair groups. Pair width equals per kind descriptor totals desc_num and overall length equals shared totals plus control plus pair count multiplied by pair width. String production follows the same order.

Shared receive and transmit totals are computed locally as column sums over per pair values using helper stats_sum_queue. Each shared position accumulates the same relative position from every active pair. Computation uses current pair count and runs after device and driver contributions are placed.

Device counter placement is gated by per kind selection bitmaps held in the collection context. A type is considered only when its bit is set and a reply record is accepted only when its reply kind matches the expected reply for that type. Disabled or mismatched types leave output untouched. One layout writes through per descriptor output positions qstat_offset while the other advances a running base offset past each enabled type.

Queue identity encodes pair number and direction. Pair number corresponds to half the queue identifier and direction to its parity. Global collection spans twice the current pair count. Control collection uses an identifier derived from twice the maximum pair count. Per queue output regions are located with current pair count pair number and per kind descriptor totals.

Without negotiated moderation offload the driver enforces a narrow software contract. Any requested microsecond delay is rejected as unsupported. Transmit batch depth above one and any receive batch depth other than one are rejected as invalid. Otherwise the request succeeds without device exchange and reported values collapse to fixed depths with transmit depth reflecting whether polling weight is enabled.

Transmit polling weight derives from whether transmit batch depth is set. Zero depth maps to disabled polling and any nonzero depth maps to the standard polling weight. A change of derived weight is allowed only while the link is down and otherwise fails as busy. Global updates apply to a suffix of queues for simplicity and additionally fail as busy when any affected transmit queue has an attached zero copy pool xsk_pool.

Each receive queue owns a mutex dim_lock guarding its adaptive flag dim_enabled and its cached timing intr_coal. All transitions of the flag and all updates or reads of cached receive timing hold this mutex. Deferred moderation work also holds it and rechecks the flag before programming the device.

Per queue driver counters are sampled under a sequence counter retry discipline using per queue sync state syncp. Each receive and transmit snapshot begins a read sequence copies its described counters and repeats when the sequence indicates concurrent modification. This yields a consistent view without blocking writers.

Collection context aggregates per kind descriptor totals desc_num plus expected reply extents size plus selection bitmaps bitmap plus an output array data plus a layout selector to_qstat. Kinds distinguish receive transmit and control. Totals define buffer geometry extents define reply areas bitmaps define request and accept sets and the selector chooses between direct per descriptor positions and sequential base placement.

Device statistics exchange uses a request array and a packed variable length reply. Each request element carries a queue identifier vq_index plus a type bitmap types_bitmap in device byte order. Each reply record carries its own total length size plus queue identifier vq_index plus reply kind type in device byte order followed by type specific payload. Receivers advance through the reply using the per record length.

Counter mapping tables describe movement from a source record to the output array. Each entry holds a byte offset into the source and either an implicit sequential position or an explicit output position derived from a stored byte offset scaled to counter units. Device sources are read as little endian integers while driver sources are read as sequence protected counters.

Adaptive receive moderation has disabled and enabled states at global and per queue granularity. Enabling with unchanged timing only flips the flag and issues no device command. Disabling flips the flag and then programs supplied timing. Enabling with changed timing fails as invalid and enabling without per queue offload support fails as unsupported. Deferred policy updates act only while enabled and otherwise only reset measurement state to DIM_START_MEASURE.

Statistics collection follows preparation device fetch driver snapshot and aggregation. Preparation learns geometry and selection. Device fetch is skipped when device statistics support is absent and otherwise issues one batched request for all selected queues. Driver snapshots follow per pair under sequence protection and aggregation of shared totals closes the sequence.

Resource and device failures abort without partial updates to cached moderation state. Request and reply allocation failures return out of memory. Moderation command failures return invalid and leave previously cached values unchanged. Transport failure during statistics fetch propagates its status except during ethtool collection where it only emits a warning and collection continues with driver counters.

Transmit moderation cache updates do not take the per queue mutex used for receive moderation so concurrent transmit readers rely on benign races or external serialization while receive paths serialize fully. Deferred work revalidates enable state under the mutex so a concurrent disable prevents stale programming. Per queue statistics regions are disjoint so fills for different queues do not overlap.

Capability VIRTIO_NET_F_DEVICE_STATS negotiates device counter support. Control class VIRTIO_NET_CTRL_STATS with operation VIRTIO_NET_CTRL_STATS_GET retrieves counters. When the capability is absent retrieval succeeds without device exchange.

Receive selection uses VIRTIO_NET_STATS_TYPE_RX_BASIC plus VIRTIO_NET_STATS_TYPE_RX_CSUM plus VIRTIO_NET_STATS_TYPE_RX_GSO plus VIRTIO_NET_STATS_TYPE_RX_SPEED with matching reply codes VIRTIO_NET_STATS_TYPE_REPLY_RX_BASIC plus VIRTIO_NET_STATS_TYPE_REPLY_RX_CSUM plus VIRTIO_NET_STATS_TYPE_REPLY_RX_GSO plus VIRTIO_NET_STATS_TYPE_REPLY_RX_SPEED.

Transmit and control selection uses VIRTIO_NET_STATS_TYPE_TX_BASIC plus VIRTIO_NET_STATS_TYPE_TX_CSUM plus VIRTIO_NET_STATS_TYPE_TX_GSO plus VIRTIO_NET_STATS_TYPE_TX_SPEED plus VIRTIO_NET_STATS_TYPE_CVQ with matching reply codes VIRTIO_NET_STATS_TYPE_REPLY_TX_BASIC plus VIRTIO_NET_STATS_TYPE_REPLY_TX_CSUM plus VIRTIO_NET_STATS_TYPE_REPLY_TX_GSO plus VIRTIO_NET_STATS_TYPE_REPLY_TX_SPEED plus VIRTIO_NET_STATS_TYPE_REPLY_CVQ.

Moderation offload uses VIRTIO_NET_F_NOTF_COAL for global control and VIRTIO_NET_F_VQ_NOTF_COAL for per queue control and adaptive mode. Control class VIRTIO_NET_CTRL_NOTF_COAL with operations VIRTIO_NET_CTRL_NOTF_COAL_TX_SET and VIRTIO_NET_CTRL_NOTF_COAL_RX_SET programs global timing.

Ethtool integration uses string set ETH_SS_STATS and generic port kind PORT_OTHER plus unknown markers SPEED_UNKNOWN and DUPLEX_UNKNOWN plus hash function ETH_RSS_HASH_TOP plus standard poll weight NAPI_POLL_WEIGHT. Channel and hash queries report these facts without device exchange.
